name: inspira-animated-modal
blurb: Modal with 3D flip spring animation and scroll locking.
description: An AnimatedModal using Framer Motion with spring-based 3D flip effect; includes scroll lock, click-outside close, and Escape key support.
use_when: Creating polished modals with eye-catching 3D entrance animations and controlled scroll behavior.
avoid_when: For simple modals without animation — use shadcn Dialog instead to reduce bundle size.
a11y: Escape key closes (when closeOnEsc=true); click-outside closes (when closeOnOutside=true); scroll locked; focus managed.
